q: What is the operating margin by business line in the FY2026 budget?

r.narrative: In the FY2026 budget, group operating profit is **€77.4M — a 35.7% margin** on €216.8M of net operating income. **Treasury & Markets** has the highest margin (69.3%) on a small cost base, **Private Banking** contributes the most profit (€27.8M at 42.2%), and **Retail Banking** is the lowest-margin line at 16.7% because of its branch network.

q: How does the Q3 forecast compare with the budget by legal entity?

r.narrative: The Q3 forecast is **€211.2M of net operating income, €5.6M (2.6%) below the €216.8M budget**. **MoraBanc Grup (Andorra)** carries almost all of the gap (−€5.4M) because NII reprices in retail and treasury; **Tressis**, **Boreal** and **Mora Capital** are slightly above budget on client flows.

q: What is the efficiency ratio by business line?

r.narrative: The group efficiency ratio is **60.3% in the FY2026 budget** (60.06% in FY2025 actuals, 60.7% in the Q3 forecast). **Asset Management & Investment Services** runs at 81% because the Tressis agent network and the international wealth teams are cost-heavy; **Treasury & Markets** at 30% and **Corporate Banking** at 48% bring the group down.
r.sql:
SELECT DIM_SECONDARY AS business_line,
       -SUM(CASE WHEN ACCOUNT_CODE LIKE 'opex-%' OR ACCOUNT_CODE LIKE 'da-%' THEN AMOUNT END)
         / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ACCOUNT_CODE IN ('rev-gross','rev-ded') THEN AMOUNT END), 0) AS efficiency_ratio
FROM SDP_MORABANC.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED
WHERE VERSION_ID = 2 AND FISCAL_YEAR = 2026
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;
